description: Header file defining the Messenger class for a plugin-based messaging system within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and interface implementations related to room management, messaging, and notifications.

classes.name: Messenger
classes.description: Main class implementing plugin interface, room notifications, message handling, and JSON-RPC endpoints for a messaging system.

classes.name: MsgNotification
classes.description: Inner class implementing message notification callback for a room.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Inner class implementing user join/leave callback for a room.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Inner class (conditional on USE_THUNDER_R4) implementing remote connection notifications.

methods.name: JoinRoom
methods.description: Joins a specified room with a user name.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified room.

methods.name: Created
methods.description: Handles creation of a room notification.

methods.name: Destroyed
methods.description: Handles destruction of a room notification.
